objectives.description_key: Be the first Courier to enter the marked finish area.
Be the first Courier to enter the marked finish area.

maps.name: Comms — Local assistance
maps.description: Hail Captain Vale, coordinate with another Courier, and test communication range.

consoles.name: Ship Operations
consoles.description: Set the ship’s speed with the throttle and choose a heading on the radar ring. Monitor nearby contacts while coordinating with the crew.

consoles.name: Helm
consoles.description: Fly using actual propulsion, reserves and approved navigation objectives.

stances.label: Hold position
stances.description: Automated propulsion stops and cancels destination guidance.

consoles.name: Engineering
consoles.description: Operate generation, incoming allocations, local reserves, conduits and cooling.

stances.label: Normal Power
stances.description: Generation follows demand within the requested operating limit.

stances.label: Recharge Power
stances.description: Maximum safe generation with reduced nonessential allocations to recharge reserves.

stances.label: Combat Power
stances.description: Maximum safe generation and full operating power allocations.

consoles.name: Science
consoles.description: Observe the fitted long-range sensor and share selected evidence.

consoles.name: Tactical
consoles.description: Observe the independent local sensor and coordinate ship readiness.

consoles.name: Comms
consoles.description: Hail nearby ships and known people, follow conversations and choose replies.

consoles.name: Captain
consoles.description: Review published objectives, deliberate reports and current delegation.

consoles.name: Navigation
consoles.description: Plot a waypoint and review shipwide objectives.

arguments: Propulsion supply is limiting the assigned transit.
Propulsion supply is limiting the assigned transit.

greeting.speaker: target
greeting.text_key: This is Captain Vale. We have a propulsion fault. Can you stand by?

engineer.speaker: engineer
engineer.text_key: Orin here. The drive is isolated. We can hold position while you approach.

declined.speaker: target
declined.text_key: Understood. We will keep our beacon active.

repeat.speaker: target
repeat.text_key: We are still here. Our previous arrangements stand.

help.speaker: target
help.text_key: Will you stand by while we assess the fault?

choices.text_key: We will stand by. Put your engineer on this channel.
Unable to assist. Keep your beacon active.

request.speaker: captain
request.text_key: Both Couriers, please coordinate your approach on this channel.

joined.speaker: engineer
joined.text_key: I have joined the assistance channel. Our crew are secure.

ack.speaker: captain
ack.text_key: Acknowledged. We will await your arrival.

lead.speaker: captain
lead.text_key: Which Courier can take the lead?

choices.text_key: Hold position; we need more time.

messages.body_key: Engineering reports that supply has recovered.
Equipment has stopped at its thermal limit.
The bridge has a navigation advisory.
A bridge operator requests a supply review.

fields.detail: Review the requested operation and available power/cooling.
